# Awesome Novel Skills

[中文](README.md) · **English**

> A curated list of agent skills for writing novels and web fiction with AI: market research, outlining, drafting, long-form continuity, de-AI revision, short-drama scripts, translation and publishing. Install them into Claude Code or Codex and start writing.

This list collects novel and web-fiction skills for agents such as Claude Code, Codex and OpenClaw. They cover ranking-chart analysis and book teardowns, setting and characters, outlines and chapter outlines, drafting and continuation, keeping a long serial consistent and in character, review and de-AI revision, titles, blurbs and covers, translation for overseas readers, and publishing. The list also includes skills for plotting short-drama scripts, and the downloaders and book-source tools that book teardowns depend on. Every project has been checked by hand and sorted by type, writing stage and target platform.

Most projects come from the Chinese web-novel scene (Qidian, Fanqie Novel, Jinjiang and others), and many are documented in Chinese; the descriptions below are translated. For story-writing methods beyond web novels, with an English method guide, see [Awesome LLM Storytelling](https://github.com/UnderleveledBuilder/awesome-llm-storytelling/blob/main/README.en.md).

205 skills and tools + 6 related open-source apps · metadata updated 2026-10-15

**Legend**: 🌟 featured · 📝 prompt files (not a standard skill) · 🧩 full app · 📚 target platform · 💤 not updated for 180+ days · 📦 archived · ⚠️ repo unavailable

> [!NOTE]
> "Checked by hand" means the README, directory structure and classification were reviewed; it does not mean the output was tested. Side-by-side tests live in [evals/](evals/). A skill may ship scripts, so read its SKILL.md before installing it.

## Suggested stacks

> A first pass based on each repo's README, not yet tested; will be updated after testing.

- **Chinese long-form web novel**: From ranking-chart research and book setup to a million-character serial
  - Stack: [oh-story-claudecode](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode) → [webnovel-writer](https://github.com/lingfengQAQ/webnovel-writer) → [Humanizer-zh](https://github.com/op7418/Humanizer-zh)
  - Why: oh-story handles ranking-chart analysis, teardowns and book setup; webnovel-writer keeps memory and continuity during a long serial (their drafting features overlap, so pick one as the main tool); Humanizer-zh removes AI-sounding prose at the end
- **Fanqie Novel short story**: Pick a genre niche and write one Fanqie Novel short story
  - Stack: [fanqie-radar](https://github.com/WindXRan/fanqie-radar) → [fanqie-short-story.skill](https://github.com/aby-aby111/fanqie-short-story.skill) → [fiction-humanizer-zh](https://github.com/deedeekong07-alt/fiction-humanizer-zh)
  - Why: fanqie-radar reads chart popularity to choose a theme; fanqie-short-story picks a topic by niche and produces titles and a segmented structure; fiction-humanizer-zh fixes the summary-like, report-like tone of AI fiction
- **Storytelling fundamentals (English)**: Learn and practice narrative craft systematically
  - Stack: [agent-skills](https://github.com/jwynia/agent-skills) → [story-skills](https://github.com/danjdewhurst/story-skills)
  - Why: jwynia breaks the craft down most finely, with many single-purpose skills; story-skills chains the story bible, chapters and revision into one project workflow

### Single-purpose tools: teardowns · setting · outline · characters

Each does one or two things; use them on their own or to fill gaps in an all-in-one system.

- **[Fanfic-background-assistant](https://github.com/Elowwwen/Fanfic-background-assistant)** · ★ 91<br>Background research for fan fiction: compiles sourced material on era, places, professions, institutions and more, checks drafts for factual errors and maintains a background handbook, without touching the plot<br><sub>Stages: Setting</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-09-19 · Chinese · MIT</sub>

- **[chinese-erotic-fiction-writing](https://github.com/xWebt/chinese-erotic-fiction-writing)** · ★ 45<br>Chinese adult (erotic) fiction writing skill: surveys preferences before writing, writes, expands and rewrites per writing guidelines, can learn style from a local book library, and session memory gradually converges on the user's taste<br><sub>Stages: Outline · Drafting · Review</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-08-04 · Chinese</sub><br><sub>💡 The local CLI needs Python ≥3.10 (pip install -e .) and can index a local txt library into SQLite and count technique density; user preferences are stored in sessions/ and kept out of git</sub>

- **[xin-skills](https://github.com/oscar-wang-xin/xin-skills)** · ★ 28<br>122 style-locking skills: ten-dimension style specs extracted from popular Fanqie Novel books and designated novels by Jin Yong, Gu Long and others, imitating only the prose, not the plots<br><sub>Stages: Drafting</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-09-25 · Chinese · 122 skills</sub><br><sub>💡 Each skill bundles paragraph excerpts from the source work as style samples</sub>

- **[fanqie-publisher-skill](https://github.com/amm10090/fanqie-publisher-skill)** · ★ 24<br>Publishes chapters via the Fanqie Novel author dashboard: parses local Markdown chapters, auto-fills them with Playwright, publishes now or on a schedule, with a fill-only mode and post-publish status verification<br><sub>Stages: Publishing</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-07-11 · English · MIT</sub><br><sub>📚 Fanqie Novel</sub><br><sub>💡 Needs Node.js, Python 3, Chrome reachable over CDP and a Fanqie Novel author account; it uses web automation rather than an official API, so dashboard redesigns may break it. The README has a Chinese version.</sub>

- **[wenfeng-skill](https://github.com/XTmingyue/wenfeng-skill)** · ★ 21<br>Given a novel's text, extracts its narrative model, language fingerprint, motifs, and character and plot techniques, and generates a directly callable style-imitation SKILL.md<br><sub>Stages: Market · Drafting</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-05-26 · Chinese · MIT</sub><br><sub>💡 The repo contains no source texts; bring your own novel text that you have the right to process</sub>

- **[analyze-hit-novel](https://github.com/ciel-oliver/analyze-hit-novel)** · ★ 11<br>Hit-novel teardown: six-dimension book teardown, dual timelines, three-dimension pacing, a character relationship graph as PNG, distilling the hit mechanics with chapter evidence<br><sub>Stages: Market</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-09-04 · Chinese</sub>

- **[fanqie-radar](https://github.com/WindXRan/fanqie-radar)** · ★ 9<br>Fanqie Novel ranking-chart analysis for book selection: built-in ranking snapshots and scraper, genre heat, multi-day trend diffs and a six-dimension imitation-suitability score, with an MCP server and dashboard<br><sub>Stages: Market</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-09-07 · Chinese · MIT</sub><br><sub>📚 Fanqie Novel</sub><br><sub>💡 Collects only public ranking metadata and does not download book text; needs Python 3.10+</sub>

- **[auto-fanqie](https://github.com/Kirby980/auto-fanqie)** · ★ 7<br>Auto-publishes chapters via the Fanqie Novel author dashboard: checks word count first, then opens local Chrome with Playwright, creates chapters by book title and volume, fills in the text and handles the publish dialogs<br><sub>Stages: Publishing</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-05-14 · Chinese · 3 skills</sub><br><sub>📚 Fanqie Novel</sub><br><sub>💡 Needs Node.js and @playwright/cli, and the first login requires a manual QR-code scan; the Go engine runs the fanqie-go/main.go source via go run, so the fanqie-go/main binary in the repo is never called; publish settings tick "no AI used" by default, and the default book title and volume must be changed to your own; the README's clone URL is a placeholder</sub>

- **[fictional-erotica](https://github.com/rs-skills-lab/fictional-erotica)** · ★ 6<br>Bilingual Chinese/English adult erotica scene writing and revision: adjustable explicitness, register, dialogue density and scene focus, keeping character voice and physical action continuous, for original work or fan fiction<br><sub>Stages: Drafting · Review</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-08-27 · Multilingual · MIT</sub><br><sub>💡 18+ only; the skill is in the fictional-erotica/ subfolder, and tests/ has test prompts and scoring rubrics</sub>

- **[character-card-fiction-workflow-skill](https://github.com/shigehaomingzi1/character-card-fiction-workflow-skill)** · ★ 5<br>Distills character profiles and source-text evidence from drafts, chat logs or novels to generate SillyTavern character cards, and can also expand or continue novels<br><sub>Stages: Characters · Drafting</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-06-18 · Chinese · GPL-3.0</sub>

- **[Creative-writing-skill](https://github.com/xbraindance/Creative-writing-skill)** · ★ 5<br>Uses Verbalized Sampling to offer multiple versions of ideas, openings, outlines and characters at once, auto-files drafts into a project wiki, with writer's-block diagnosis and critique commands<br><sub>Stages: Setting · Characters · Outline · Drafting · Review</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-04-28 · English · MIT</sub><br><sub>💡 General creative writing (including poetry), not specific to long-form; the repo includes a 12 MB paper PDF</sub>

<a id="group-script"></a>
### Scripts · short drama: plotting with web-novel craft

Short drama, manju and web novels share the same plotting craft and differ only in presentation. This section covers the plotting side: adaptation, episode outlines, hooks, scripts and review. For storyboards and video prompts, see [awesome-short-drama-skills](https://github.com/UnderleveledBuilder/awesome-short-drama-skills/blob/main/README.en.md).

<a id="group-companion"></a>
### De-AI · polishing

Makes text read less like AI wrote it. Not limited to fiction, but web-novel authors use these the most.

- 🌟 **[Humanizer-zh](https://github.com/op7418/Humanizer-zh)** · ★ 19.8k<br>Chinese adaptation of blader/humanizer: cleans out empty phrasing and template sentences using 31 checkpoints (6 specific to Chinese), keeping facts, degree of certainty and the author's tone<br><sub>Stages: Review</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-09-23 · Chinese · MIT</sub><br><sub>💡 General Chinese polishing, not fiction-specific; rules come from blader/humanizer, rewritten for Chinese</sub>

- 🌟 **[lieflat-less-ai-tone](https://github.com/larashero3-dotcom/lieflat-less-ai-tone)** · ★ 2.8k<br>Tests 26 AI-tone features against a 2.83-million-character human-vs-AI corpus and rewrites only by the 11 that passed, with a reproducible detection script<br><sub>Stages: Review</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-08-24 · Chinese · MIT</sub><br><sub>💡 General Chinese, not fiction-specific</sub>

### Translation · going overseas

<a id="group-sources"></a>
### Source material: novel downloaders · book sources

A book teardown starts with the original text. These tools download novels, generate book sources and scrape chapters; agents can call the CLI tools directly.

- **[Yuedu](https://github.com/XIU2/Yuedu)** · ★ 12.5k<br>Book source collection for the Legado reader app: 22 curated novel book sources the author uses personally (Qidian, Fanqie Novel, 69shuba, etc.), with network import and QR-code import<br><sub>Stages: Market</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-08-14 · 🧩 app · Chinese · GPL-3.0</sub><br><sub>📚 Qidian · Fanqie Novel</sub><br><sub>💡 Must be used with gedoor/legado (the Legado reader app); few sources, and the author says maintenance is not active. Whole books cached in the app can be exported as TXT.</sub>

- **[legado](https://github.com/aoaostar/legado)** · ★ 6.9k<br>Book source collection for the Legado reader app: about 3,900 book sources in total, plus subscription sources, content-cleanup rules, layout and read-aloud engine configs, one-click import<br><sub>Stages: Market</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-10-15 · 🧩 app · Chinese</sub><br><sub>💡 Book sources are synced on a schedule by a bot; the Git repo doesn't support one-click import, so import from legado.aoaostar.com</sub>

- **[work_crawler](https://github.com/kanasimi/work_crawler)** · ★ 4.3k<br>Node.js batch downloader for novels and comics: novel support covers Qidian, Biquge-family sites, Syosetu (Shōsetsuka ni Narō), Kakuyomu and more, outputs EPUB, with an Electron UI<br><sub>Stages: Market</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-10-12 · 🧩 app · Multilingual</sub><br><sub>📚 Qidian</sub><br><sub>💡 About 60% of site modules are for comics. Release installers are still at v2.14 from 2022; fixes from the last two years require running from source.</sub>

- **[Tomato-Novel-Downloader](https://github.com/zhongbai2333/Tomato-Novel-Downloader)** · ★ 4k<br>Fanqie Novel downloader (Rust): search and download via TUI and Web UI, export to TXT/EPUB/PDF, optionally with paragraph comments, and generate Edge TTS audiobooks<br><sub>Stages: Market</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-09-02 · 🧩 app · Chinese · MIT</sub><br><sub>📚 Fanqie Novel</sub><br><sub>💡 Rewritten in Rust from the Python Dlmily/Tomato-Novel-Downloader-Lite, adding EPUB, resumable downloads, search and a Web UI. The default build depends on a private Official-API crate, and the third-party chapter-text API address and token are not open source; the public source builds with Cargo_no_official.toml, which has no search or paragraph comments. The CLI can only update already-downloaded books; new books need the TUI or Web UI.</sub>

- **[lightnovel-crawler](https://github.com/lncrawl/lightnovel-crawler)** · ★ 2.7k<br>Crawler for English web novels/light novels: 361 sites (including Royal Road and Webnovel), generates EPUB/TXT and more with one command, plus a self-hosted web library and translation<br><sub>Stages: Market</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-09-11 · 🧩 app · English · 7 skills · GPL-3.0</sub><br><sub>📚 Royal Road</sub><br><sub>💡 Install with pip install lightnovel-crawler. Originally dipu-bd/lightnovel-crawler, now moved to the lncrawl organization; the old URL redirects automatically.</sub>

- **[fanqienovel-downloader](https://github.com/ying-ck/fanqienovel-downloader)** · ★ 2.4k<br>Python downloader for Fanqie Novel: CLI download by ID/link, search, batch downloads and updates of downloaded books, plus a web version with a queue and online reading, exports TXT/EPUB<br><sub>Stages: Market</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-08-16 · 🧩 app · Chinese · AGPL-3.0</sub><br><sub>📚 Fanqie Novel</sub><br><sub>💡 The web version can run in Docker; the exe in Releases is a packaged build and source is in src/. A 2026-07 community PR switched to curl_cffi to handle anti-scraping.</sub>

- **[novel-downloader](https://github.com/404-novel-project/novel-downloader)** · ★ 2k<br>General-purpose novel download userscript: one-click download from the table-of-contents page, covering 100+ sites including Qidian, Jinjiang (JJWXC), Fanqie Novel, Qimao, SF, ESJ and Wenku8, outputs TXT+EPUB<br><sub>Stages: Market</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-10-13 · 🧩 app · Chinese · 2 skills · AGPL-3.0</sub><br><sub>📚 Qidian · Jinjiang (JJWXC) · Fanqie Novel · Qimao</sub><br><sub>💡 For sites without a login wall, with your consent it archives detail/TOC pages to archive.org and reports info such as IP and UA. Jinjiang and Fanqie may need manual font matching; Jinjiang chapters can use an App token. The .claude/skills in the repo are for maintainer development, not writing skills.</sub>

- **[NovelForge](https://github.com/RhythmicWave/NovelForge)** · ★ 1.2k<br>Card-based long-form tool: generates setting, character and outline cards structured by JSON Schema, injects context with an @DSL, keeps consistency with a knowledge graph, and orchestrates code-style workflows (including book teardown)<br><sub>Stages: Market · Setting · Characters · Outline · Drafting · Memory</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-09-23 · 🧩 app · Chinese · AGPL-3.0</sub>

- **[OpenFic](https://github.com/syrizelink/OpenFic)** · ★ 1.2k<br>Human-AI collaborative novel tool: writing editor plus customizable Prompts/Agents/workflows, maintains settings, characters and foreshadowing, vector retrieval over million-character projects; supports Docker, pip and a desktop version<br><sub>Stages: Setting · Characters · Drafting · Memory</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-10-15 · 🧩 app · Multilingual · Apache-2.0</sub><br><sub>💡 Positioned as collaborative writing, not one-click book generation. The README contains promotional links for an API reseller.</sub>

<a id="resources"></a>
## Resources

- [awesome-llm-storytelling](https://github.com/UnderleveledBuilder/awesome-llm-storytelling/blob/main/README.en.md): open-source methods for getting LLMs to tell stories, indexed by 12 methods such as planning, long-form memory, multi-agent review and de-AI, with a method guide; goes beyond web novels to scripts, tabletop RPG and narrative nonfiction
- [awesome-short-drama-skills](https://github.com/UnderleveledBuilder/awesome-short-drama-skills/blob/main/README.en.md): AI short-drama and manju skills; continue there to adapt a novel into a short drama
- [anthropics/skills](https://github.com/anthropics/skills): the official Agent Skills repo with the spec and examples, a good starting point for writing your own skill
- [vercel-labs/skills](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills): the `npx skills` installer, with the [skills.sh](https://skills.sh) directory
- [VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills](https://github.com/VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills): a general list of agent skills

## Contributing

Suggest a project by [opening an issue](../../issues/new?template=submit-skill.yml), or edit `data/skills.toml` and open a PR; see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) (in Chinese; English issues and PRs are welcome). Your own novel skill is welcome too.
